headline: Wall Street Opens Stronger on AI Stock Rally Despite Netflix Forecast Drag
summary: U.S. stocks nudged higher as strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro boosted appetite for AI-linked shares, though Netflix shares fell following a weaker-than-expected growth outlook.
why: Broader market indices reflect investor sentiment across major sectors, where technology earnings and artificial intelligence demand heavily influence overall equity movements.

impacts.name: Netflix Inc
impacts.why: Netflix shares fell following a weaker-than-expected growth outlook.

why_moved: U.S. stocks nudged higher on strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro, while Netflix shares declined following a weaker-than-expected growth outlook.
